_comment: Sample recipes. Unpublished until cooked at least once by a tester (PRD §11.2).

recipes.name: Curry mince & rice
recipes.description: Mild mince curry with potatoes, on rice.
steps: Brown the onion in oil, add the mince and cook until browned.
Stir in curry powder, then the tomatoes and diced potato.
Simmer 20 minutes until the potato is soft. Cook the rice meanwhile.
Season and serve on rice.

recipes.name: Chicken stew & pap
recipes.description: Chicken portions stewed with carrots and potatoes, with soft pap.
steps: Brown the chicken in oil, then add the onion.
Add carrots, potatoes, stock and water; simmer 35 minutes.
Cook the pap: boil water, stir in maize meal, cover and steam 20 minutes.
Serve the stew over the pap.

recipes.name: Pilchard fishcakes & chakalaka
recipes.description: Crispy pilchard and potato fishcakes with warm chakalaka.
steps: Boil and mash the potatoes.
Mash the pilchards (bones and all) with the potato, onion, egg and flour.
Shape into cakes and fry in a little oil until golden.
Warm the chakalaka and serve on the side.

recipes.name: Samp & beans (umngqusho)
recipes.description: Classic samp and sugar beans, slow-simmered with onion and tomato.
steps: Soak samp and beans overnight; rinse.
Boil together in fresh water for about 1 hour 15 minutes until soft.
Fry onion and tomato in oil and stir through with stock.
Season and serve.

recipes.name: Soya mince bolognaise
recipes.description: Budget bolognaise with soya mince and carrots on spaghetti.
steps: Fry onion, garlic and grated carrot in oil.
Add soya mince, tinned tomatoes, tomato paste and a little water; simmer 15 minutes.
Cook the pasta.
Season with herbs and serve.

recipes.name: Cabbage & boerewors
recipes.description: Pan-fried boerewors with braised cabbage and potatoes.
steps: Fry the boerewors in a pan until cooked; set aside.
In the same pan fry onion, then add shredded cabbage and diced potato with a splash of water.
Cover and cook 15 minutes until soft.
Slice the wors back in and serve.
